correctness.rationale: For commuting normal coefficients A and B, Fuglede double commutation cancels cross terms of T=S tensor A + S* tensor B; the unilateral-shift identities give [T*,T]=P0 tensor D, D=A*A-B*B. Positivity, respectively zero, of D characterize hyponormality and normality. For a subnormal restriction T=N|M to invariant M of a normal N, <[T*,T]x,x>=||(I-P_M)N*x||^2; hence ker[T*,T] is T-invariant. Since z tensor h belongs to that kernel for all h, T(z tensor h)=z² tensor Ah+1 tensor Bh forces DBh=0. Conversely D>=0 and DB=0, with commuting normal functional calculus, split H=ker D plus its reducing orthogonal complement; B vanishes on the latter. The first Toeplitz summand is normal and the second S tensor A has the normal bilateral-shift extension. This proves the iff for infinite- and finite-dimensional H and boundary D=0/B=0.
